correctness.rationale: For all n>=5 disconnected triples in complement cycles are exactly consecutive triples, yielding Alexander duality. The cited path-ideal Theorem 4.6 gives concentration. Signed Lefschetz numbers are orbit-selection sums. A four-state transfer with characteristic polynomial lambda(lambda-1)(lambda^2+1) evaluates every rotation, and a reflection endpoint recurrence with F_{j+2}=-F_j evaluates both reflection types; ambient permutation sign transports the characters. These combine into the claimed rational D_n modules. Independently the package verifier checks every dihedral group element for n=5 through 15 and mod-two Betti ranks through n=10. Those finite checks do not prove the infinite claim.

value.rationale: For a natural infinite family of complementary cycles and a standard topological graph invariant, determines the full symmetry representation beyond previously known mod-four Betti ranks. Distinguishes orientation line signs modulo eight, separates reflection types and identifies a rational order-four constituent that dimensions cannot detect. Useful for equivariant topology and quotients; no broad downstream theorem is claimed.
